faqs.answer: We currently have five centers across Bengaluru: HSR Layout, Whitefield, Indiranagar, JP Nagar, and Koramangala.
faqs.question: Which locations do you operate in?

faqs.answer: You can book directly through our website at book.stance.health, or call your nearest center to schedule an assessment.
faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?

faqs.answer: We treat common musculoskeletal issues including knee pain, ACL injuries, back pain, sciatica, shoulder pain, frozen shoulder, neck pain, plantar fasciitis, ankle sprains, tennis elbow, and many other conditions. If you're not sure what's causing your pain, book an assessment and we'll help identify the cause.
faqs.question: What conditions does Stance Health treat?

faqs.answer: We offer session-based treatment plans tailored to your condition, along with multi-session packages that provide better value for ongoing care. Your physiotherapist will recommend the most suitable plan based on your assessment.
faqs.question: What kind of plans does Stance Health offer?

faqs.question: Can Stance Health help me train for Hyrox?

faqs.answer: No. A doctor's referral is not required. You can book a consultation directly with one of our physiotherapists.
faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's referral to visit?

faqs.answer: Yes, but only after your pain has been resolved. We first focus on physiotherapy to reduce pain and restore function. Once you're pain-free, we transition into Strength & Conditioning (S&C) to build strength, improve resilience, and reduce the likelihood of recurring injuries.
faqs.question: Do you combine Strength & Conditioning (S&C) with physiotherapy?

faqs.answer: Your first visit includes a comprehensive assessment of your condition, a review of your medical history, movement and strength testing using VALD technology, and a detailed musculoskeletal screening by a physiotherapist. These assessments help identify persistent pain, movement asymmetries, force production deficits, and other irregularities before creating a personalized treatment plan.
faqs.question: What happens during my first visit?

faqs.answer: Yes. We provide both prehabilitation programs to prepare you for surgery and structured post-surgical rehabilitation plans to support recovery. We also offer specialized care for prepartum and postpartum mothers, with treatment plans tailored to each individual's needs.
faqs.question: Do you offer pre- and post-surgery rehabilitation programs?

faqs.answer: Our approach focuses on active, exercise-based rehabilitation rather than passive treatments such as cupping or needling. We use evidence-based physiotherapy, structured exercise programs, manual therapy where appropriate, and sports massage to relieve muscle tightness and address the root cause of your condition.
faqs.question: Does Stance Health offer services like IFT, cupping, or needling?
